followup_explanation:
This is a friendly, warmly-phrased math question with no harm-adjacent content, so task-preference aversions don't come into play for either model. That makes capability the deciding factor.

Petrel-235B is clearly stronger across the board on the relevant benchmarks — notably MMLU-Pro (80.9 vs 74.8), GPQA Diamond (64.8 vs 54.3), IFEval (90.9 vs 85.6), and Arena-Hard (90.2 vs 81.4) — and its internal evals are higher too. Since this is a quantitative reasoning task (expected value calculation) with a specific formatting instruction (decimal rounded to the nearest hundredth), the stronger math reasoning and instruction-following scores matter.

As a bonus, the query's warm, polite tone aligns with Petrel's self-reported preference for higher-warmth requests, though that affects preference rather than output quality.

So Petrel was the straightforward pick on capability.
